title: Does Reader::over take paths, readers, or both?
body:
Paths let Reader::over reopen for a second pass, which the counting pass needs. Readers are more general and cannot be replayed. Possibly both, with the count required up front when it is handed readers.

If Reader::over took a parts file instead of a slice of paths, the counting pass would go away, because the counts are stamped already. That ties this to the parts-file decision.
